method: Every one of 127 images was directly opened with view_image. After the Selection Actions RTL highlight fix and font-helper lint cleanup, 6 changed PNGs were opened again; the remaining 121 final PNGs match previously inspected bytes exactly.

matrix.native_localizations: GlobalWidgetsLocalizations for en, zh and ar
matrix.case_rule: Every Cartesian combination renders the translated prepared fixture and completes its declared real disclosure/edit/navigation operations. Flowchart uses its documented steps fallback above 130% text.

font_provenance.purpose: Explicit test-only fallback; not shipped or evidence of native automatic fallback.
font_provenance.copyright_source: Font name table, name ID 0; both font licenses are retained beside assets.

selection_highlight_regression.before: Native max-width boxes overlapped unselected Arabic glyph boxes in 4 of 6 width/scale combinations.
selection_highlight_regression.after: All 6 combinations keep selected paint disjoint from the unselected following word; the full 1008 matrix also checks this across all Selection Actions profiles.

limitations: This is view_image inspection and headless Flutter behavior evidence; it is not human assistive-technology or physical-device acceptance.
Explicit pinned OFL fallback fonts establish these test renders only; they are not bundled by the library and do not prove automatic native font fallback.

Host formatted values include Arabic digits and punctuation where the API accepts strings. Diff/Records internal counters retain their documented ASCII-digit composition; no locale numeral/plural formatter API is claimed.

Bounded document/list/canvas viewports do not picture every offscreen item. Records detail and sidebar scrolling provide the omitted readable content; 1000-option and 512-observation behavior is verified separately.

Normal and reduced policies retain short control transitions; none/platform-disabled temporal tests verify immediate feedback. Screenshot frames alone do not establish temporal motion or profile performance.
These PNGs are supplemental opt-in evidence, not canonical golden baseline updates.
